dataset_status: 12 development cases from four private source incidents; no held-out split

validation.compute: One sequential CPU rollout worker; no GPU, inference provider or live messaging. Observed local validation timing, not an isolated throughput benchmark.

remaining_failure.note: Synthetic gust exercise still has unresolved fire. Retained as a failure, not a demonstration or proof of infeasibility.

limits: This compares deterministic baselines on development fixtures, not trained models or held-out generalisation.
Historical response duration informs an assumed transit component; it does not identify real travel time.
Weather, fleet readiness, terrain, populations, communication scripts and fire effects remain synthetic.
No source control/extinction time or final burned area forces a rollout outcome.
Shelter, in-person warning teams, road networks, historical weather joins and new OpenEnv/model-server wiring remain unsupported.
Reward checks are verifiable in this simulator, not calibrated real-world safety or optimal-action labels.
Existing regional and generated benchmark scenarios and rewards remain separate; old ops default behaviour is regression-tested.
